title: Silent Hill
subtitle: (the video game)
review: Not as good as {Resident Evil 2}, which was released the year before. The graphics are great for the first PlayStation if you ignore the draw distance, but it's hard to do so as it's so incredibly short. I like the constant ominous sounds and the general atmosphere in the game. I liked how much you rely on filling in a paper map with notes as you explore. Some of the weak points are the repetitive combat and the vague and incongruous puzzles. The boss fights are easily the least fun parts. It's no masterpiece but it did start a series that hit some real high points later on. The North American box art for this game is amusingly bad.
spoilers: I got the bad ending and it was so abrupt it made me laugh. It cuts to credits immediately after defeating the worst final boss of any game I can remember. But there was a funny dancing scene after the credits for some reason, and I liked that.
